ios.desc:
Save and manage your favorite places - 100% private, 100% local

Loki Radar lets you save places, POIs, and locations directly on your iPhone. No cloud, no tracking, no accounts - your data stays yours.

KEY FEATURES
• Full-screen map with search, long-press, or POI selection
• Smart search by address, coordinates, or saved places
• Filter by country or postal code
• Organize places into custom lists
• Travel Mode: activate a list to focus the map, Nearby, and notifications on just those places
• Share lists via AirDrop and import lists you receive – peer-to-peer, no servers
• One-tap navigation with Apple/Google Maps
• Optional proximity notifications when near saved places (uses background location)
• Exploration fog: the map starts under fog and clears for good where you go (uses background location)
• Available in English, German, and Japanese
• Dark/Light mode support

PERFECT FOR
• Travel planning
• Saving parking spots
• Managing favorite locations
• Business locations
• Offline use without roaming

LOKI PRO
Loki Radar is free to use – save unlimited places, get proximity alerts, and create one list. Loki Pro unlocks the full experience with a single one-time purchase (no subscription):
• Unlimited lists
• Travel Mode
• Share & export your lists via AirDrop
• Exploration fog
Receiving and importing a shared list is always free.

PRIVACY FIRST
All data stored locally. No servers, no sync, no analytics. Exploration fog stays on the device too: only a coarse grid of visited areas is stored, without timestamps or order. What you save stays on your device – and sharing a list is always your choice (peer-to-peer via AirDrop, never automatic).

Built for iOS 18 with native performance.

Note: Proximity notifications and the exploration fog require "Always" location permission. Both are completely optional and off by default. Without it the app works fully – the exploration fog then only uncovers the map while Loki Radar is open.
